skill.name: softsync-forms

content.user_title: Manage SoftSync Forms and Submission Records
content.value_statement: Public form workflows require tracking links, submission access, and the records created by answers. This skill guides connected assistants through SoftSync form management and response lookup.
actual_capabilities: List forms with their public links, open status, and destination tables.
Inspect a form's requested fields and behavior after submission.
Guide form creation using workspace tables, groups, and field apiName values.
Update form names, open status, thank-you messages, and post-submission destinations.
Delete forms while retaining existing records, or replace public links to invalidate old links.
Find submitted answers through search_records on the destination table, ordered newest first.
limitations: Creating, changing, and deleting forms require the Admin role.
Field ordering, destination changes, and appearance changes must be handled in the app.
Answers have no separate list; they must be retrieved as records from the destination table.
The skill provides instructions only; compatible SoftSync tools and workspace access must already be available.

use_cases.title: Collect New Contacts
use_cases.description: Create a contact intake form with first and last name fields, then retrieve new contact records.

use_cases.title: Manage Event Registration
use_cases.description: Share a registration form and close submissions after confirming that registration should end.

use_cases.title: Replace an Overshared Link
use_cases.description: Generate a replacement public link when a form URL reaches an unintended audience.

prompt_templates.title: List Available Forms
prompt_templates.prompt: List the forms in my workspace with their public links, open status, and destination tables.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Contact Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a contact form in [table] and [group] using first name, last name, and email fields. Share its public link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: create a form with Admin access.

prompt_templates.title: Close Registration
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [form] and explain the effect of closing submissions. Ask for confirmation before closing it, then verify its status.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: manage a form's submission lifecycle.

prompt_templates.title: Rotate a Link and Review Answers
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace the public link for [form], report the replacement, and retrieve its latest [count] answers from the destination table, newest first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: combine link replacement with record retrieval.

output_examples.input: Describe the setup for a contact form requesting a person's name and email.
output: Fields: first name, last name, and email, using their workspace apiName values.
Destination: the selected workspace table and group.
The form opens immediately when created, and each answer creates a record.
Creating the form requires Admin access.

output_examples.input: Explain how closing a form differs from deleting it or replacing its link.
output: Closing stops new answers while leaving the form available for later management.
Deleting stops the public link from working but preserves records already created.
Replacing the link creates a new public URL and invalidates the old link immediately.

best_practices: Check the destination table, group, and field apiName values before creating a form.
Confirm before closing or deleting a form because existing link holders will lose submission access.
Review requested fields before sharing a public URL, since anyone with the link can submit answers.
anti_patterns: Share a form link without checking that the form opens immediately and collects the intended fields.
Delete a form expecting its previously created records to disappear.
Attempt field reordering, destination changes, or appearance edits through the documented form tools instead of the app.

faq.question: Who can submit a public form?
faq.answer: Anyone with the public link can submit while the form is open.

faq.question: Where do form answers appear?
faq.answer: Each answer becomes a record in the destination table. Use search_records on that table to retrieve answers.

faq.question: Which role is required to manage forms?
faq.answer: Creating, changing, and deleting forms require the Admin role.

faq.question: Can I change field order or form appearance?
faq.answer: Use the app to reorder fields, change the destination, or adjust appearance.

faq.question: Does deleting a form remove submitted records?
faq.answer: No. The public link stops working, but records already created are retained.

faq.question: What happens when I replace a public link?
faq.answer: A new public link is generated, and the previous link stops working immediately.
